summary: Missing provisional hourly buffer credit on month-end invoice after cross-region postback reroute
description: Issue summary: Customer reports that provisional hourly buffer credit expected on the month-end invoice is missing after a cross-region postback reroute that occurred during a maintenance window. Impact: BlueNova Labs reports a $1,200 variance on their finalized invoice; affects revenue recognition and customer trust. Environment: Dedicated tenant (BlueNova), prod: us-east, observed region fallback to eu-west during maintenance on 2026-02-28 23:45 UTC. Observed behavior: hourly buffer credits that were present in provisional console estimates did not appear on the finalized invoice. Expected behavior: accrued hourly buffer credits (warmup/reserve) should be applied to month-end invoice lines matching the provisional report and console estimate. Attachments: customer invoice (redacted), console estimate screenshot, postback webhook bundle exported by customer.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Schedule maintenance that triggers cross-region ingress failover (us-east -> eu-west) for a short window.
2) Run a burst of microbatch embed jobs that trigger hourly-buffer warmup on the dedicated pool between 23:30-00:10 UTC.
3) Allow postback router to reroute postbacks to eu-west due to temporary region tag refresh.
4) Finalize billing run for the month and compare provisional console estimate to finalized invoice lines.
5) Observe missing hourly buffer credit lines on the final invoice for the affected hours.

comments: 2026-03-01 Diego Alvarez: Opened ticket after customer submitted invoice and console screenshots showing a $1,200 delta. Customer asks for timeline and provisional credit application explanation.
2026-03-01 Support Triage (Lena Morales): Acknowledged; requested full invoice PDF and postback bundle. Set first response SLA to 2026-03-02.

2026-03-02 Billing Eng (Arun Patel): Confirmed billing-aggregator logged an hourly-buffer mismatch for tenant blue-nova for hours 23:00-00:00 UTC. Requested reconciler traces and postback delivery receipts.

2026-03-03 SRE (Marta Chen): Found that several postbacks were routed to eu-west with X-Region-Tag eu-west; there was a transient tag normalization issue between router and reconciler for tenant prefixes created before 2025.
2026-03-03 Support (Lena Morales): Notified customer of investigation status and provided expected timeline for fix (48 hours) and temporary billing credit if reconciliation confirms loss.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: postback-resequencing during cross-region failover caused the postback-reconciler to drop hourly-buffer acknowledgements for a subset of warmup events.
Billing logs show provisional accruals were recorded by console estimation but finalization job only applied credits present in reconciler-delivered postbacks.
Reconciler trace: sequence gaps at seq=1123-1127 where the reconciler's dedupe window expired before late-arriving postbacks from eu-west were ingested.
Router behavior: router re-tagged some postbacks with legacy tenant prefix mapping, causing reconciler to index them under a different meter key for that tenant.
resolution: Short-term workaround: Billing team to run a targeted re-ingest for late postbacks matching tenant=blue-nova and hour=2026-02-28T23:00Z; provisional credits will be applied as a one-off adjustment if re-ingest confirms delivery receipts.

Patch deployed: postback-reconciler v1.14.2 includes extended dedupe window and more robust tenant-prefix normalization logic (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/postback-reconciler/pull/410). Deployed 2026-03-03 to staging; rollout to prod scheduled for 2026-03-04 with canary traffic first.

Compensation: If billing re-ingest cannot fully recover the missing credits, a manual invoice credit will be issued and documented; finance notified to prepare provisional credit memo for BlueNova Labs.

Follow-ups: Retroactive audit of all tenants with legacy prefix mapping during the maintenance window (2026-02-28 23:30-00:30 UTC) to identify other potential under-credited invoices (owner: Billing Eng, due 2026-03-08).
